Documentary evidence spans four thirty-year settlements: 1839-42, 1872-79, 1903-08, and 1938-39 [S25b51ad4a1f3].

draft_quotes: The 1877 Wajib-ul-arz recorded joint possession since Sambat 1880, noting that collaterals like Amir Khan and Sharif Khan were entered as proprietors over time, maintaining joint ownership without partition [Sde2ad06bee15][S1c8953c93a98][Sb36d38285a62].

Paragraphs 5 and 7 confirmed the 'bilijmal' (joint) tenure, stating Dalmir's sons paid revenue for all shares due to relationship ties, and no single sharer could reclaim banjar land without consent [S75f388f02fc5][S42da4091ca29].

Khewat and Khatauni papers consistently recorded all five branches as possessing equal 1/5th shares [S9eb062f6a7de][S47def472a3c1]. Conversely, the 1903-08 Wajib-ul-arz clause 3 explicitly stated that only Dalmir's descendants could partition, barring others due to non-rendition of accounts [Sd9a4ca069cbc].

draft_quotes: The trial court... decreed for the plaintiffs, limiting defendants to produce rights [S3dcb2f432439].

However, the Lahore High Court reversed this decree on November 10, 1944 [Se4468e3042fe]. The High Court held that the defendants were proprietors with an inherent right to partition. It ruled that the restrictive agreement dated September 28, 1861, incorporated into the Wajib-ul-arz, was binding only during the currency of the Settlements and ceased to have effect upon their expiry. Furthermore, the renewal of these terms in the 1938-39 Settlement was not binding because the contesting defendants did not agree to them [S4b2b3a6e0136].

In the current appeal (Civil Appeal No. 61 of 1951), appellant counsel Dr. Tek Chand contended that the appellants had acquired title by adverse possession over the defendants' share for more than 56 years [S869d8c8c61ea].

Witness Mehrab, a plaintiff, admitted that defendants were shown as proprietors in the Jamabandi and that he raised no objection to this or to sales by co-sharers, suggesting potential estoppel issues under Evidence Act Section 115 [S7c5282f5f79b][L65ec615070d2].
